description: Lists the projects in this organization, each with its id, name, and framework. Read-only, takes no arguments, and returns only the projects the calling credential may see. Call it first in a session: the returned id is the project_id that every other tool in this server requires, and guessing that id fails. It does not return components, packages, or tokens - use list_components, list_packages, or get_style_tokens for those.
name: list_projects
title: List projects
